content.text:
The pattern matches Ba2SmReO6 (mp-13929) alone.

**Observed peaks.** The main reflections fall at about 29.5° (100), 42.2° (28), 52.4° (41), 61.3° (17), 69.6° (19) and 77.3° (6). There is also a weak bump near 20.6°. These positions were estimated by eye from the intensity list, so they carry a few tenths of a degree of uncertainty.

**Fit to mp-13929.** Ba2SmReO6 is a cubic double perovskite (Fm-3m). The given primitive cell edge of 6.061 Å converts to a conventional cubic edge of 8.571 Å. The expected reflections from that cell are:

| Reflection | d (Å) | Calculated 2θ | Observed 2θ |
|---|---|---|---|
| (200) | 4.29 | 20.7° | ~20.6° (weak) |
| (220) | 3.03 | 29.45° | ~29.5° |
| (400) | 2.14 | 42.1° | ~42.2° |
| (422) | 1.75 | 52.2° | ~52.4° |
| (440) | 1.515 | 61.1° | ~61.3° |
| (620) | 1.355 | 69.3° | ~69.6° |
| (444) | 1.237 | 77.0° | ~77.3° |

Every observed peak lines up within about 0.3°, with a consistent slight shift. No peaks are left unexplained, so a second phase is not needed. I did not check the other eight candidates line by line. I rely on the complete fit to this cubic pattern rather than on ruling them out explicitly.

{"present": ["mp-13929"], "confidence": 0.9, "note": "All observed peaks index to the cubic double-perovskite Ba2SmReO6 cell (a about 8.57 Å), with no unexplained reflections."}
